info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Individual Enrollments API
Get a list of all Individual Enrollments for a Dependent

params.name: dependent_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the employee for which you would like to view individual enrollments

params.name: effective_date
params.description: The relative date on which to view the state of the record

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

items.docs: Returns a list of all individual enrollments for a given dependent.
